'''Holocrystals''' were [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] receptacles that could store images.<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Fitz Roi]] was presented with a holocrystal showing his stolen [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]] by [[Aliea Tanner]], president of the [[Fitz Fan Club of Amander Public School|Fitz Fan Club]] of [[Amander Public School]].<ref name="GNN6">{{JournalCite|6|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> [[Huoba Neva]] kept a holocrystal of her family with her at all times.<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
